document.title: Elementris — Learn element families
document.description: Learn element families with a short, guided periodic table lesson.

lesson.title: Meet two element families
lesson.intro: Six small tiles. Two sides of the table.
lesson.description: An element family is a group of elements with similar properties. Let’s get to know two of them.
lesson.hydrogen: Hydrogen sits above the alkali metals, but is not an alkali metal.
lesson.pace: Tap the highlighted family. No timer. Take your time.
lesson.completeDescription: You followed the guides. Replay to get familiar with the names and symbols.
lesson.placeInstruction: Tap the highlighted family to place the tile.
lesson.collection: The columns collect families, not exact table positions.

feedback.guide: {{element}} is in the {{family}} family. Follow the guide above.
feedback.incorrect: {{element}} belongs to the {{family}} in group {{group}}. Try the highlighted column.

alkali.name: Alkali metals
alkali.description: Reactive metals on the left of the table.

noble.name: Noble gases
noble.description: Very unreactive gases on the right of the table.

orientation.label: Periodic table overview: alkali metals in group 1 on the far left, excluding hydrogen; noble gases in group 18 on the far right. The detached rows are omitted.
